title: neoporteria neohankeana
intro: Neoporteria neohankeana, commonly known as the "Andes rose" or "Rose of the Andes", is a species of flowering plant in the family Cactaceae. This plant is known for its unique appearance, with bright pink flowers and a distinctive growth habit. Neoporteria neohankeana has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, pain, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
